## Earnie 2.5.0-alpha.1

Community **pre-release** of the **2.5** line. Focus: full **15‑min MILP** slots (`dt_h = 0.25`) after investigation **2.5.a–c** (decision B).

### Highlights

- **Quarter-hour MILP** — explicit `dt_h` through SoC, cost, wear, delivery energy, EV math; Live Energy-Charts with aWATTar expand fallback; flex `*_quarterhours` as real slots
- **Downstream** — cons_data / PV / outdoor / feature hour-hold; charts 1:1 QH; `commit_hours` → slots
- **2.5 features** — battery standby; Netznutzung Arbeitspreis in optimization + fake invoice; Optimierer-Dienst log-level filter; Chart-1 SoC ESS-mode underlay
- **Also in this alpha tip** — EV SOC-Min-Immediate ASAP floor; manual Startempfehlung opportunity-cost ranking; Chart-1 known peel / EV latch / pool filter fixes

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.0-alpha.1` only (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (already pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.4.0**).

See [docs/spec/quarter-hour-slots.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/docs/spec/quarter-hour-slots.md) · [backlog/Backlog.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/backlog/Backlog.md).
